EC1: - Known immunodeficiency disorder, including positive serology for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) at screening, [OR] or a first degree relative with a hereditary immunodeficiency.
EC2: - Infection with hepatitis B [OR] or hepatitis C viruses.
EC3: - Participants with selected acute or chronic infections [OR] or infection history.
EC4: - Participants have a known present [OR] or a history of malignancy other than a successfully treated [OR] or excised non metastatic basal cell [OR] or squamous cell cancer of the skin.
EC5: - History of alcohol abuse [OR] or binge drinking [OR] and/or any other illicit drug use [OR] or dependence within 6 months of Screening.
EC6: - Use of tobacco/ [OR] nicotine containing products within 3 months prior to dosing or positive urine cotinine test.
